If "mixed mode" is enabled, I2P torrents are allowed to also get peers from other sources than the tracker, and connect to regular IPs, not providing any anonymisation. This may be useful if the user is not interested in the anonymisation of I2P, but still wants to be able to connect to I2P peers.
